verdict.rationale: Gmail's support docs clearly document native snoozing: a snoozed email leaves the inbox and returns at a chosen time, and snoozed mail is searchable with `in:snoozed`. Nothing in the pack shows follow-up reminders that resurface a thread when nobody replies, so only half the story is evidenced (Streak's API-built snoozing is third-party and earns no credit). Missing for 10: documented no-reply follow-up reminders/nudges, independent hands-on corroboration of snooze.

support.subject: As a power-user, I can snooze conversations and set follow-up reminders that resurface a thread if nobody replies

citations.quote: When you snooze an email, the email is removed from your inbox temporarily in Gmail.
Your email comes back to the top of your inbox when you want it to, whether that's tomorrow, next week, or in the evening.
To search for snoozed emails, at the top, in the search bar, enter `in:snoozed`.
